title: Machines
noBackend: This version of LordOS can't run machines.
emptyHint: A machine runs another system in a window, in its own sandbox. Start from a disk image or an ISO.
deleteDetail: The machine and its disks go to the Trash. You can restore them from there until you empty it.
deleteFailed: “{name}” couldn't be moved to the Trash.
bad.newer: Made by a newer version of LordOS
why.qemu-failed: The machine's engine stopped with an error.
why.guest-panic: The system inside it stopped with an error.
why.supervisor-lost: Its supervisor ended unexpectedly; it will be cleaned up at the next start.
why.forced: It didn't shut down in time and was turned off.
fix.qemu-signal: Start it again; if it keeps happening, the log below says where.
fix.out-of-memory: Give it less memory, or close other machines, and start it again.
fix.start-failed: The log below says what is missing.
fix.guest-panic: Start it again; if it keeps happening, the system inside needs repair.
fix.forced: Unsaved work in the machine may be lost.
win.gone: This machine isn't in the Machines folder any more.
win.cantAttach: The machine is running, but this window couldn't connect to it.
win.startingHint: The picture appears as soon as the machine shows one.
win.shuttingDownHint: The system inside is asked to shut down. If it doesn't answer, it is turned off after a minute.
win.noDisplayHint: This machine runs without a display.
req.title: Machines needs a few system parts
req.kvm: This computer has it, but your account can't use it yet. Without it, machines are much slower.
req.noKvm: This computer offers no hardware virtualization: machines are emulated, much slower.
req.notAdmin: An administrator of this computer has to do this.
new.title: New Machine
new.name: Name
new.memoryMax: Up to {max} MB on this computer
new.importHint: The image is copied into the machine; the original stays as it is.
new.isoHint: The ISO is attached read-only and the machine starts from it.
new.rootPassword: Root password for the first start (optional)
new.rootPasswordHint: Some images ask for it the first time they start (Debian's cloud images do). Only its hash is kept, until the machine's first clean shutdown.
new.err.nameBad: Use a shorter name, without control characters.
new.err.nameTaken: There is already a machine with that name.
new.warn.vcpus: More than {n} leaves this computer little to work with while the machine runs.
new.warn.emulated: Another architecture is emulated: expect it to be many times slower.
new.warn.noKvm: Without hardware virtualization this machine is emulated, much slower.
